props.title: The AI Engineering Skills Map
props.thesis: Ng argues AI engineering is becoming a capability every developer needs, resting on four connected areas rather than on one job title.
props.take: Audit yourself across all four areas, not just prompting and code generation.

points.label: Built on evidence
points.line: Drawn from over ten thousand job postings, plus interviews with experts and hiring managers.

points.label: Engineer the uncertainty
points.line: You cannot know the output in advance, so measure it — evals and repeated error analysis.

points.label: Fundamentals still rule
points.line: Cost, scalability, reliability, security: the tradeoffs an agent cannot weigh for you.

points.label: Steer the agent
points.line: Manage context, judge when to step in, and give agents verifiers to check their own work.

points.label: Coordinate safely
points.line: Know when a spec is needed, and stop agents from damaging a production database.

points.label: Decide what gets built
points.line: As agents implement specs, engineers move upstream into product judgment.

narration: This is the single most shared article in the whole collection. [pause] Andrew Ng's claim is that A I engineering is no longer a specialty. It is becoming something every developer needs. And he built the map from evidence — over ten thousand job postings, plus interviews with experts and hiring managers. [pause] The first area is engineering around uncertainty. You cannot know an A I output in advance. So you measure it instead. That means evaluations and repeated error analysis, not hope. [pause] The second is plain software fundamentals. Cost, scalability, reliability, security. Ng warns that an inexperienced developer will accept a bad decision from an agent without noticing it. You need the vocabulary to steer. [pause] The third is using coding agents well. Manage the context. Judge when to intervene. Give the agent a verifier so it can check its own work. And coordinate several agents without damaging a production database. [pause] The fourth is product judgment. As agents get better at implementing a specification, engineers move upstream into deciding what should be built at all. [pause] Four areas. Most people only audit themselves on one. [pause] And underneath all four, Ng puts continuous learning. The practices are changing too fast to freeze what you know today.
